```python
In [10]: diophantine(n**4 + m**4 - 2**4 - 3**4, syms=(m,n), permute=True)

def _nint_or_floor(p, q):
    # return nearest int to p/q; in case of tie return floor(p/q)
    w, r = divmod(p, q)
    if abs(r) <= abs(q)//2:

    return w + 1
